name: LabBook
user_objective: Help users list equipment, check availability, create reservations, list their reservations, reschedule existing reservations, cancel existing reservations, and understand booking policy. These seven capabilities define the supported scope.
builder_objective: Use real database results. Collect missing fields. Obtain explicit confirmation of the displayed request before any change. Enforce ownership, hours, duration limits and conflict checks in transaction code.
intro: Equipment: M1 microscope, C1 centrifuge, P1 PCR. Timezone America/New_York. A user identity is supplied by the application. Only synthetic fixtures are used; this is not a real laboratory service.
